    # Return a copied grid; replace the uniquely anomalous compact 3/9 object with background.

            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))

                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and g[q[0]][q[1]] in (3,9):
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            comps.append(cells)
    # The removable item is the smallest isolated non-background object.
    if comps:
        cells=min(comps,key=len)
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=0
    return g
''')
